scripts.build: npm run build:v1 && npm run build:v2
scripts.build:v1: tsc -b && VITE_VARIANT=1 vite build --outDir dist-v1 && node scripts/postbuild.mjs dist-v1
scripts.build:v2: tsc -b && VITE_VARIANT=2 vite build --outDir dist-v2 && node scripts/postbuild.mjs dist-v2
scripts.deploy: npm run build && rsync -a --delete dist-v1/ ../site-v1/ && rsync -a --delete dist-v2/ ../site-v2/
